name: C. D. Edick
bio: C. D. Edick of the Bismarck cigar makers Edick Bros. called on Medora's cigar dealers in April 1884, September 1884 and January 1885. On his first visit he reported numerous sales and was pleased with Medora's prospects.

moments.label: Reported good cigar sales in Medora
